description.value: Fort Berens Estate Winery is Lillooet's first winery, established in 2009 on sagebrush-covered benchland along the Fraser River at the foot of the Coast Mountains — a striking high-desert setting unlike any other BC wine region. The tasting room sits above the vineyard with panoramic views and no reservations required for drop-in visits. The winery sits at the halfway point of the scenic Coast Mountain circle tour via Highways 99, 12, and 1, making it a natural destination stop for cyclists traveling between Whistler and the BC interior.
